text:
ellie (AE): Quick summary from Avalon run this morning — attached heatmap + tail percentiles. We hit 1.8k sustained QPS with 99th ~ 420ms on their average prompt set. Need ops to confirm can reproduce on Dedicated sizing.
joe (SE): nice — can you drop the exact request mix + prompt lengths? especially ratio chat vs short-gen.
ellie (AE): roughly 60% chat (~200 tokens avg), 30% 64-token completions, 10% embeddings. Attached sample set in /tmp/avalon-sample-2026-03.json (not in thread).
tim (SRE): thx. Quick note: the test used caching disabled, right? that 1.8k is cold-kv baseline we should expect improvements with prefix cache.
ellie (AE): correct, cache off to measure worst-case. Avalon asked us to show tail without cache.
sara (Solutions): if we want to propose Dedicated sizing, i'd recommend showing a warmed run too. Can we run a 20m warm + 10m steady at target QPS?
ellie (AE): can do. planned command below for automation — please sanity-check:
```bash
loadtest --target 1800 --duration 30m --concurrency 600 --pattern poisson 
--payload-file avalon-sample-2026-03.json --cache-disabled
```
joe (SE): looks fine. maybe reduce concurrency to 400 first to measure latency tail ramp. Poisson pattern is good.
matt (Infra): re: Dedicated sizing, on our default quantized variant (q4f16) expect ~12% higher tail than fp16 for same QPS. Want me to run fp16 vs q4f16 comparison?
ellie (AE): yes please — Avalon asked about quantization/price tradeoffs. Also they want an estimate for monthly committed capacity.
sam (Security): quick security flag — Avalon requires KMS integration + SOC2 reqs. For the POC we can use token scrubbing and customer-managed keys in Private. Need their KMS endpoint and IAM role. Are we collecting any PII in the sample prompts?
joe (SE): sample set scrubbed, no PII. We'll send a short description for the security questionnaire.
ellie (AE): price ask from procurement: estimate for 2.5k sustained with 20% burst capacity and 99.9% uptime SLA. Need numbers by EOD tomorrow.
omitted (deploy-bot): deploy started: perf-runner/2026-03-23T08:12Z (build #942)
tim (SRE): i'll spin up reproduction on Dedicated staging cluster. Ping me when warm run scheduled, i'll attach perf logs and per-token cost calc.
sara (Solutions): i'll draft a short slide: "Warm vs Cold baseline" + cost delta for fp16 vs q4f16. Use the 30m warm + 10m steady numbers.
matt (Infra): starting fp16 vs q4f16 runs now. will post a CSV with lat/p99/p50 and estimated token/sec cost.
ellie (AE): perfect. Also adding Avalon PM (cc: @avalon-pm) to loop once we have warmed numbers.
joe (SE): one more ask — could we include a brief test of KV cache effectiveness? i.e., 10% repeated prefixes to show cache hit improvement. Small run, 5m.
tim (SRE): yep. I'll run: `--pattern poisson --cache-enabled --repeat-rate 10` and compare.
ellie (AE): thanks all. tagging checklist: 1) warmed run + cold run csv, 2) fp16 vs q4f16 cost table, 3) KV cache delta, 4) short security note, 5) monthly commit estimate.
sam (Security): i'll draft the security note — need KMS details + whether logs stay in their VPC.
matt (Infra): fp16 run done — uploading CSV to /artifacts/avalon/5087654321/fp16.csv (will DM link).
joe (SE): i'll compile everything into single doc for procurement. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
ellie (AE): awesome, wrapping up here. will post final results thread when compiled.
